title: Read recent email
steps: Ask "What are my latest emails?" and "Do I have anything unread from <name>?"
expected: It lists the right emails from your Outlook inbox with sender, subject and a short summary.

title: Find and summarize an email
steps: Ask "Find the email from <name> about <topic> and summarize it."
expected: It finds the right email and the summary matches what it says.

title: Send an email
steps: In the web chat, say "Email <name> that the pilot starts Nov 10."
expected: It shows the draft first and sends only after "confirm". The email arrives from your account with the right content.

title: Reply to an email
steps: After N3.2, say "Reply and say I'll get back to them Friday."
expected: It drafts a reply in the same thread, shows it first and sends only after "confirm".
